note: Portable cross-stack v2 (ML-DSA-65+Ed25519 composite) conformance vectors. The construction is profile-invariant; each hardening fixture must render the SAME verdict as its v1 twin. The agile engine (noble/JS) and the agile Go oracle (CIRCL) must agree byte-for-byte. A v1-only verifier must return UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE (exit 3) on the valid v2 bundle — proven in run-v2-stacks.mjs.

valid_variants.desc: v2 unicode non-ASCII signed reason field (canon is profile-invariant)

adversarial.desc: v2 signed_extra_receipt_field — 16th own key on a validly-composite-signed receipt; rebuilt+resigned
v2 signed_missing_receipt_field — composite-signed receipt missing 'reason'; rebuilt+resigned
v2 signed_proto_receipt_key — '__proto__' own key on a composite-signed receipt; rebuilt+resigned
v2 signed_extra_checkpoint_field — 8th key on the checkpoint, checkpoint re-signed (composite) over the 8-key body
v2 tampered checkpoint algorithm value
v2 envelope_gateway_id_lie — UNSIGNED bundle.gateway_id differs; all composite-signed objects intact
v2 envelope_merkle_root_lie — UNSIGNED bundle.merkle_root wrong 64-hex; signed objects intact
v2 envelope_generated_at_lie — UNSIGNED bundle.generated_at differs from signed checkpoint.generated_at
v2 signed_unparseable_timestamp — composite-signed receipt timestamp "not-a-date"; rebuilt+resigned
v2 signed_decreasing_timestamp — two composite-signed receipts with decreasing timestamps; rebuilt+resigned
v2 ts_invalid_calendar — Feb 29 2026 (not a leap year); regex passes, integer calendar check fails; rebuilt+resigned
v2 mt_direction_token — directions[0] "right"->"RIGHT" (UNSIGNED edit; NOT re-signed)
v2 mt_sibling_uppercase — siblings[0] hex UPPERCASED (UNSIGNED edit; NOT re-signed); lowercase-64-hex guard rejects
v2 depth_bomb — receipt field is a ~3000-deep nested array (NOT re-signed); depth-bounded canon -> FAILED, never crash
v2 tamper_receipt_signature — flip one nibble of a receipt composite signature -> AND-verify FAILS
v2 tamper_checkpoint_signature — flip one nibble of the checkpoint composite signature
v2 composite_sig_trailing_byte — extra byte appended to a receipt composite signature; decodeComposite rejects trailing bytes
v2 composite_sig_truncated — a receipt composite signature truncated by one byte; component-length / decode fail
v2 composite_sig_uppercase — a receipt composite signature UPPERCASED (UNSIGNED, same bytes); lowercase-strict hex guard rejects (the v2 hex-case cross-stack split)
v2 checkpoint_sig_uppercase — the checkpoint composite signature UPPERCASED (UNSIGNED, same bytes); lowercase-strict hex guard rejects
v2 composite_key_all_zero — all-zero composite public key (right length); rejected by composite key well-formedness
v2 composite_key_wrong_length — composite public key one byte short; structural floor fails
v2 identifier_mismatch_checkpoint — bundle.algorithm=v2 but checkpoint.algorithm=v1; checkpoint binding requires cp.algorithm === bundle.algorithm
v2 downgrade_relabel_v1 — a composite-signed bundle relabeled algorithm=v1; the v1 key well-formedness rejects the 3984-hex composite key

trichotomy.desc: the valid v2 bundle handed to a v1-only verifier must return UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE (exit 3), NOT FAILED
